name: Brotherly Love
label: Quest
description: Brotherly Love: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Tragic... My brother faces me on the field of battle: A commander for the Stormpike.
Of the four Stormpike Commanders, he is undoubtedly the most dangerous. Perhaps if he is slain, the Banshee Queen could turn him as she did me - show him the error of his ways...
Deep within enemy territory you will find my brother. Slay him and return to me. I trust that you are capable of completing this mission, soldier.
And soldier, do not go alone.

clips.title: Progress
paras: How it must pain him to remain as one of the living while his beloved brother has ascended to perfection.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Your heroics will not go unnoticed, friend.
I must waste no time if he is to be saved. Sylvanas must be contacted!
